scope: First run only: approach to wanted-broadcast reaction

assets.title: A · Market approach
assets.cue: Opening premise and the plan to split
assets.purpose: A shaded planning alcove beside a public lane. Ordinary information display, twin blue tanks and teal shade point toward the target; cargo cranes plant the distant objective.
assets.watch: Place the pair in the cool alcove, watching the lane. The first display carries useful local information, not their wanted alert.

assets.title: B · Water broker’s forecourt
assets.cue: Hang on back → all attention → grab the thing → fade away
assets.purpose: A public stall attached to the criminal’s private house. Chair, private tanks and storage gate express control of water; open public space and screened service cover support the theft.
assets.watch: Harper works the conspicuous side and draws pursuit into the left passage. Taffy uses cover beside the chair and withdraws through the right service gap. Chair eyelines need blocking.

assets.title: C · Blue-pipe reunion court
assets.cue: First Are you with me? → Together anyways
assets.purpose: Two approaches meet on a pump-service landing under a chipped blue pipe elbow. A higher screened ledge and lower dogleg let them arrive separately; right stairs lead onward.
assets.watch: Reunite here before the next entrance. The study has more running water than the sparse trickle proposed; flow can be reduced during location refinement.

assets.title: D · Service entrance and relay hall
assets.cue: We use that / This like that → walk on in → News!
assets.purpose: A controlled entrance into a port-serving utility/freight hall. Door-jamb reader outside, large broadcast screen inside, and onward cargo ramp beyond.
assets.watch: The screen is blank for a later wanted-broadcast overlay using the selected identities. Refine the reader in a prop close-up: the concept renders a rounded C/P recess, not a precise horseshoe socket.

lyricCues.label: Observe and brief
lyricCues.text: Adventure premise and plan to split. They deliberately read useful information. Harper explains the separate roles before presenting herself alone.

lyricCues.label: Stay behind; she acts alone
lyricCues.text: Harper moves into the public forecourt; Taffy hangs back in screened cover. Criminal associates must not see that they arrived together.

lyricCues.label: All attention on Harper
lyricCues.text: The jewel presentation catches racketeer, associates and shoulder lookout. Keep their sightlines away from Taffy and the device.

lyricCues.label: Take the override key
lyricCues.text: Taffy lifts the asymmetric horseshoe device while attention is held elsewhere. Make object identity readable without interrupting the concealment.

lyricCues.label: Separate disappearances
lyricCues.text: Harper takes the visible public exit and loses pursuit in the lower dogleg. Taffy vanishes along the screened service ledge. Both head to the blue-pipe court.

lyricCues.label: Check and reunite
lyricCues.text: First refrain: is he there, did it work? A discreet glimpse of the key and reunion under the blue pipe elbow. They leave together.

lyricCues.label: A different entrance
lyricCues.text: Arrive at a controlled freight/utility entrance beyond the market. This is one step toward the port, not the ship itself.

lyricCues.label: Learn the device
lyricCues.text: Match and orient the stolen asymmetric device in the door-jamb reader. Proposed action: initial wrong orientation, then turn it to fit. No second theft.

lyricCues.label: Cross the threshold
lyricCues.text: Use the opened door and enter the relay hall. The wanted display belongs inside, so the reveal follows the access success.

lyricCues.label: The broadcast is about them
lyricCues.text: They notice the wanted broadcast after entry. News / Big news / I never watch the news carries discovery and reaction. Exact portraits and text are a later controlled overlay.

continuity: Stable topological connections; camera-specific geometry and reader insert remain development work
